name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1842: v1841 fixed a chip that referenced the undefined token --fs-tiny, then described the fix in the build note using that exact callable spelling. D2R_BUILD.note is a JS string literal inside bible.html and v1733s token gate strips block comments but not string literals, so it read the sentence about the token as a live reference and stayed red. The fix re-created the defect it fixed, one line down. bump_version.py now refuses a note naming a token in callable form, the same way it already refuses an apostrophe.
